translations.source_sense_description: bis zu einer neuen Entscheidung gültig

glosses: Temporary, but with the intention of eventually becoming permanent or being replaced by a permanent equivalent.

examples.text: Marsden and Jones were named in the provisional squad for the European Championships, to be confirmed before the 30 June deadline.
The provisional date for the wedding is April 2, but it is subject to confirmation at the church.

glosses: A postage stamp issued locally before an official issue is released.

examples.text: If this was not possible, then alternatives including provisionalizing with a complete denture or a tooth-supported fixed provisional and a staged treatment protocol should have been considered.

translations.source_sense_description: bis zu einer neuen Entscheidung gültig

glosses: Not permanent; existing only for a period or periods of time.

examples.text: Sally was put in temporary charge of the department while they searched for a full-time replacement.

glosses: Existing only for a short time or short times; transient, ephemeral.
One serving for a limited time; a short-term employee, especially in an office.
A short-term variable used to store an intermediate result.

translations.source_sense_description: bis zu einer neuen Entscheidung gültig

glosses: Qui se fait en attendant une autre chose, préalablement à une autre chose qui sera définitive.

examples.text: Au jour, j'inspecte minutieusement les avaries et consolide les réparations provisoires de la nuit.
Nous avons fait un arrangement provisoire.
Ce n’est là qu’un établissement provisoire.
Gouvernement provisoire.

glosses: Qualifie un jugement rendu par provision.

examples.text: Jugement, sentence, arrêt provisoire.

Les aliments, les réparations, etc., sont matière provisoire.
Demande, exécution provisoire : celle qui a lieu nonobstant l’appel du jugement.
Ordonner, prononcer l’exécution provisoire, avec ou sans caution.
Il a gagné le provisoire.
Introduire un provisoire.
